Title: [Environment/Security] CORS rejects requests from Vite fallback port 5174
Steps: 1. Start Vite on port 5174. 2. Attempt API login from frontend.

Title: [Budget Tracker] Budget item creation fails due to missing userId in payload
Steps: 1. Login and go to /budget. 2. Click Add Item and submit form.
Expected: Item saved and visible in list.
Actual: 500 error / User not found with ID: null.

Title: [Guest List] Guest creation fails due to missing userId in payload
Steps: 1. Login and go to /guests. 2. Click Add Guest and submit form.
Expected: Guest saved and visible in list.
Actual: 500 error / User not found with ID: null.

Title: [User Account] Auth API 401 error handler masking login failure messages
Steps: 1. Go to /login. 2. Enter invalid password. 3. Submit.

Title: [Guest List] Search and filter controls hidden when guest list is empty
Steps: 1. Log in with empty guest list. 2. Navigate to /guests.
Expected: Search input and RSVP filter tabs visible.
Actual: Controls completely hidden until first guest is added.
